name: Jaume Portell
bio: Jaume Portell is Founder and CEO of PageMind.ai, which uses AI to bridge the gap between technical product language and the questions e-commerce customers are actually asking. He has over sixteen years of experience as CEO and co-founder of Beabloo and has held CTO roles at Exoticca and eDreams. With a computer science background from UPC and an MBA from ESADE, he has been building technology products for nearly three decades.
